steps.name: Install pinned pnpm and the frozen lockfile
Secret scan of tracked files (gitleaks 8.30.1, checksum-verified)
argv: curl -sSfL -o /tmp/gitleaks.tgz https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz && echo '551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb  /tmp/gitleaks.tgz' | sha256sum -c - && tar -xzf /tmp/gitleaks.tgz -C /tmp gitleaks && src=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$src" && /tmp/gitleaks dir "$src" --no-banner --redact --verbose --exit-code 1

steps.name: Build and pack the npm tarball once, record its digest
argv: pnpm run build && mkdir -p .ci-results/dist && pnpm pack --pack-destination .ci-results/dist && (cd .ci-results/dist && sha256sum *.tgz | tee SHA256SUMS)

steps.name: Install the packed tarball cleanly and run the CLI
argv: (cd .ci-results/dist && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); proj=$(mktemp -d); cp .ci-results/dist/*.tgz "$proj/"; cd "$proj"; npm init -y > /dev/null; npm install --no-audit --no-fund ./*.tgz; want=$(node -p "require('./node_modules/@kyanitelabs/epoch/package.json').version"); got=$(./node_modules/.bin/epoch --version); echo "epoch --version: $got (package $want)"; test "$got" = "$want"; ./node_modules/.bin/epoch --help > /dev/null
